name: Columbina
title: Welkin Moon's Homecoming
description: The Moon Maiden born in Nod-Krai, and also the welkin moon returning home.

skillTalents.name: Moondew Cascade
skillTalents.description: Normal Attack Summons Moonlit Tides, performing up to 3 attacks that deal Hydro DMG . Charged Attack Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Hydro DMG after a short casting time. If you have at least 1 Verdant Dew Verdant Dew When party members trigger Lunar-Bloom reactions, the party will receive such a resource. Your party will receive 1 Verdant Dew every 2.5s for 2.5s after triggering a Lunar-Bloom reaction. Your party can have up to 3 Verdant Dew. If you trigger another Lunar-Bloom reaction during this time, the duration of this effect will be reset. , Columbina's Charged Attacks will be replaced with the special Charged Attack Moondew Cleanse , which will not consume Stamina: Consume 1 Verdant Dew to deal 3 instances of AoE Dendro DMG to opponents in front. This DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG. Plunging Attack Plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Hydro DMG upon impact with the ground.

skillTalents.name: Eternal Tides
skillTalents.description: Awaken Moonbound Tides, dealing AoE Hydro DMG and summoning Gravity Ripple Gravity Ripple After unleashing Elemental Skill Eternal Tides, Columbina will summon Gravity Ripple . Gravity Ripple will follow the current active character on the field, while continuously dealing AoE Hydro DMG to surrounding opponents. Additionally, while Gravity Ripple is on the field, and nearby party members trigger Lunar reactions or inflict Lunar Reaction DMG, Columbina will gain the New Moon's Omen effect for 2s, continuously accumulating Gravity. 20 Gravity can be accumulated every 2s. You can have up to 60 Gravity, and it will be removed when the duration of Gravity Ripple ends. Once Gravity is accumulated to its limit, a special Gravity Interference will be triggered. Different effects will be triggered depending on the Lunar reaction type that has accumulated the most Gravity for Columbina. If the Lunar reaction type that has accumulated the most Gravity for Columbina is: Lunar-Charged: Gravity Interference will deal a single instance of Electro AoE DMG . This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG. Lunar-Bloom: Gravity Interference will fire 5 Moondew Sigils at surrounding opponents, dealing Dendro DMG . This DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG. Lunar-Crystallize: Gravity Interference will deal a single instance of Geo AoE DMG . This DMG is considered Lunar-Crystallize DMG. . Gravity Ripple will follow the active character on the field, while continuously dealing AoE Hydro DMG to surrounding opponents. While Gravity Ripple is on the field, and nearby party members trigger Lunar reactions or inflict Lunar Reaction DMG, Columbina will accrue a special Gravity . Once Gravity is accumulated to its limit, different types of damage will be dealt to enemies based on the type of Lunar Reaction that has accumulated the most Gravity for Columbina. Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam : Gravity Ripple inflicts AoE Hydro DMG over a wider area.

passiveTalents.name: Moonlight, Lent Unto You
passiveTalents.description: When a party member triggers an Electro-Charged , Bloom , or Hydro- Crystallize reaction, it will be converted into a Lunar-Charged , Lunar-Bloom , or Lunar-Crystallize reaction respectively. Lunar Reaction DMG inflicted by party members gain a Base DMG increase based on Columbina's Max HP . For every 1,000 points of Max HP, the Base DMG of Lunar reactions is increased by 0.2%, up to a maximum of 7%. Additionally, when Columbina is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.

passiveTalents.name: Lunar Vigil
passiveTalents.description: If one of your party members is incapacitated while in the Nod-Krai region, Columbina will revive this character. The amount of HP the character will have upon revival is based on Columbina's Friendship Level . This effect can occur once every 100s. This effect does not trigger in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss. Additionally, Columbina appears to have a special affinity for certain animals who are influenced by kuuvahki...

constellations.name: Radiance Over Blossoms and Peaks
constellations.description: Description Gameplay Notes Unleashing her Elemental Skill Eternal Tides will immediately trigger an effect equivalent to the effect of Gravity Interference Gravity Ripple After unleashing Elemental Skill Eternal Tides, Columbina will summon Gravity Ripple. Gravity Ripple will follow the current active character on the field, while continuously dealing AoE Hydro DMG to surrounding opponents. Additionally, while Gravity Ripple is on the field, and nearby party members trigger Lunar reactions or inflict Lunar Reaction DMG, Columbina will gain the New Moon's Omen effect for 2s, continuously accumulating Gravity. 20 Gravity can be accumulated every 2s. You can have up to 60 Gravity, and it will be removed when the duration of Gravity Ripple ends. Once Gravity is accumulated to its limit, a special Gravity Interference will be triggered. Different effects will be triggered depending on the Lunar reaction type that has accumulated the most Gravity for Columbina. If the Lunar reaction type that has accumulated the most Gravity for Columbina is: Lunar-Charged: Gravity Interference will deal a single instance of Electro AoE DMG . This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG. Lunar-Bloom: Gravity Interference will fire 5 Moondew Sigils at surrounding opponents, dealing Dendro DMG . This DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG. Lunar-Crystallize: Gravity Interference will deal a single instance of Geo AoE DMG . This DMG is considered Lunar-Crystallize DMG. . This effect can be triggered once every 15s. Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam When Gravity Interference is triggered, if the Lunar reaction type that has accumulated the most Gravity for Columbina is: Lunar-Charged : Your current active character will recover 6 Energy . Lunar-Bloom : Your active character's interruption resistance will be increased for 8s. Lunar-Crystallize : Summons a Rainsea Shield . The Rainsea Shield's DMG absorption is based on 12% of Columbina's Max HP , and it will absorb Hydro DMG with 250% effectiveness for 8s. All nearby party members' Lunar Reaction DMG is elevated Elevation Special DMG Boost effect. It is calculated independently of other DMG Boost effects. by 1.5%. As the appropriate Lunar reaction type of the instant Gravity Interference effect is not guided by the gradual accumulation of Gravity through normal combat, it is instead determined directly based on the Elemental Types of characters in the party. When there is a majority of Electro , Dendro or Geo characters (with a fixed tie-breaker priority in this same order), the instant Gravity Interference will behave as if that respective element's Lunar reaction type had accumulated the most Gravity.
